notes.title: Playtest - 🔧Patch 4🔧
notes.notes:
Hello! A small update while going into the weekend:



Campaign / Camp

Fixed a rare crash that occurred during interactions with friendly Figurines.

Fixed Figurine spawning logic, now allowing stronger enemies to appear in high-Chaos provinces.

notes.title: Playtest - 🔧Patch 2 & 3🔧
notes.notes:
Dear Testers!



Your feedback is important to us, and to improve your experience during the final days of playtesting, we've addressed several bugs and issues. Thank you for your vigilance — and please remember to share with us your structured feedback through the form 📋 Band of Crusaders - Playtest Feedback 📋. Let me quote here our crusaders — "GOD WILLS IT"!



The full list of updates includes:



Campaign / Camp

Fixed a bug where NPC Figurines could get stuck in an infinite idle loop after a combat with another NPC Figurine

Fixed a bug where Faith and Injury tooltips could remain attached to a cursor

Fixed a bug where the "Empty Beds" notification would appear even when all wounded Crusaders were already assigned to healing slots

Fixed a bug where it was impossible to dismiss an Infirmary building "Empty Beds" notification

Fixed a bug where Chaos could exceed 100% in a given province

Fixed a bug with incorrectly displaying enemy portraits on the Engagement Screen

Combat

Fixed a bug where the game could crash during exiting from combat

Fixed a bug leading to a significant performance drop during combat with a Stonegut and Everburning Stonegut

notes.title: Playtest - 🔧Patch 1🔧
notes.notes:
Dear Anointed Testers of Band of Crusaders!



Thank you for sharing with us your suggestions as well as information about the bugs and issues you've encountered. Based on your feedback, we've prepared a patch that fixes several bugs and introduces some minor balance changes to improve your experience.

To give you time to try out the update, we're extending the Playtest until Sunday, June 15th.

Even if you already shared your thoughts with us on Discord or different channels, we'd greatly appreciate you providing a structured feedback through the form 📋 Band of Crusaders - Playtest Feedback 📋, which will help us to draw more conclusions to make a better game!



The full list of updates includes:



Menus and Settings

Fixed bug where the Exit to Menu button in the Pause Menu exited the game.

Continue button no longer present in the Main Menu (feature not existing).

In Graphical Settings, clarified that Windowed Fullscreen works only with the native resolution. 

Campaign map

The Story Quest episodes now correctly recognize the player choosing Option 2 in dialogues.

Fixed a bug where completed Story Quests did not disappear from the Quest Log.

Increased the amount of Chaos in southern provinces, resulting in more Abominations and Cultists appearing there.

Fixed a bug leading to Escort Merchant type quests being unable to complete.

Fixed a bug where Figurines were getting stuck on the bridge near Lyon.

Fixed a bug where Figurines were pushing or blocking each other. This should also remove the problem of Figurines getting stuck in rivers.

Fixed a bug where Cultist Figurines were not attacking.

Fixed missing texts in quest objectives (Vermin's End, Henry the Rat, Treesingers, Gloombranch, Cutting Trees).

Improved the balance of low-quality variants of equipment items (e.g. items with 'broken' prefix are now just 30–40% cheaper than regular items.

Combat

Fixed a bug in the Beelzebub fight that caused a significant FPS drop.

Greatly decreased the chance that the player party to be hard-blocked by environment randomization. To achieve this, crusader groups now always load in a default formation (not one previously used by the player).

Increased weapons durability: all weapons by 100%, and Polearms by 200%.

Improved terrain in the Swamp biome battlemap to prevent characters from getting below it.

Fixed a bug where the Bandit Leader, the player’s target in the Recover the Banner quest, could be a non-elite enemy.

2 Hellhounds are now present at the Recover the Banner map. We're curious to see how creative players will take advantage of this [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/1f609/32.png"]

Added spawn randomization for the player party in Bandit Camp combat levels.
